# BaFin notices fixtures (authored, fictional)

Every file here is **authored** in the documented provider shapes (BF01,
`docs/development/bafin-notices-evidence/source-audit.md`) and names fictional
issuers (Musterwerke AG, `DE000MSTR014`; Beispiel Maschinenbau SE,
`DE000BSPL026`), fictional companies and fictional persons. The ISINs and LEIs
carry valid check digits but belong to no real entity. Nothing here is captured
or downloaded data, and none of it is evidence of live coverage.

The dated file names give the order in which the tests observe them: a later
voting-rights export carries a correction, a later dealings export no longer
lists one transaction, and later short-position lists drop positions.
